name: Woodlore, LLC
description: Located in Rockbridge County, Virginia, Woodlore LLC is an environmentally conscious business which salvages local trees that have fallen from storms and urbanization. Instead of harvesting trees, we save dead or diseased trees from being processed into non recyclable products such as firewood, and mill them into natural live edge slabs. We sell local wood and build custom furniture.  Some of our featured products include tables, desks, benches, mantels, countertops and bar tops. These custom pieces display the log’s unique spalting, feathering, ambrosia, voids, inclusions, and knots; and may artistically expose nails, bullets, barbed wire and various other articles lodged in the tree. In addition, portable sawmill services are available for clients who wish to reclaim logs from their property and create their own heirloom furniture. We also offer kiln drying services with our iDRY vacuum kiln.  Our mission is to offer new life to dead trees, and thereby provide customers with organic furnishings and artisan materials. Our philosophy is to care for the environment by crafting furniture with locally salvaged trees.  Woodlore values honesty, integrity, and quality craftsmanship.
